methodology.google: Approximate Google Search demand for Romania from Google Ads Keyword Planner historical metrics when authorized. Search volume is demand, never sales.
methodology.reddit: Authorized Reddit Data API when configured; otherwise only public search-index evidence. Community mentions are not sales.
methodology.facebook: Only public/indexable or explicitly authorized/exported evidence. No bypass of Meta group access restrictions.
methodology.forums: Public forum pages and public search-index evidence only.
methodology.guide: Anonymous canonical intent if the metrics endpoint exposes canonical intent entities; raw personal search histories are not used.
methodology.universe: RTA, POD, mod and rebuildable-hardware products observed in Romanian retailer evidence plus reviewed RTA models.
methodology.truthRule: Retailer sales/bestseller evidence remains primary. Search and community signals can corroborate buying interest; they are never reported as sales.

googleAds.source: Google Ads Keyword Planner historical metrics
